quotes.text: We did the Little Havana walking tour and food tour today with Sophia as our tour guide and she was amazing! So knowledgeable and very funny! All of the food was so good and learning about the Cuban culture we so neat! A great way to experience the best shops and even watch cigar rollers! This was probably one of the best guided tours I’ve done anywhere! Def a must do if visiting Little Havana!
